en.title: Accessibility Daily Digest: Disability Rights, Barrier-Free Travel, and Housing Advocacy
en.summary: Today's digest covers key accessibility developments: Ireland's Basic Income for the Arts scheme is under scrutiny for its accessibility to artists with disabilities, prompting questions about adequate support and participation barriers. In Australia, a wheelchair user is calling for 'common sense' after receiving a fine threat for using an accessible parking zone without a permit, highlighting ongoing challenges with accessible infrastructure. For travelers, new guidance offers tips on maximizing barrier-free tours for individuals with disabilities. Meanwhile, two housing advocates have been honored for promoting fair, affordable, and accessible housing, emphasizing the continued need for inclusive housing options. Additionally, the Hoover Institution has made Friedrich August von Hayek's papers accessible online, marking a significant academic resource availability.

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日新聞摘要：殘疾權利、無障礙旅遊及住房倡議
zh-TW.summary: 今日摘要涵蓋主要無障礙發展：愛爾蘭藝術基本收入計劃因對殘疾藝術家的無障礙性受到審視，引發關於充分支持及參與障礙的問題。在澳洲，一名輪椅使用者在使用無障礙停車區而無許可證收到罰款威脅後呼籲「common sense」，突顯無障礙設施的持續挑戰。為旅客提供新指南，分享殘疾人士如何充分利用無障礙旅遊的技巧。同時，兩位住房倡導者因促進公平、可負擔且無障礙住房而獲表彰，強調對包容性住房選項的持續需求。此外，胡佛研究所已將弗萊德里希·奧古斯特·馮·哈耶克的論文開放線上存取，標誌著重要學術資源的重大進展。
